description: Rete di comunicazione stradale e ferroviaria (DBPRIOR10k) - Umbria is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.umbriaterritorio.it. The service allows you to consult the road and rail communications network of the Umbria Region on the basis of the database created as part of the project of the State-Regions-Local Authorities on Geographical Information Systems (IntesaGIS), DBPrior10k, in Gauss-Boaga Fuso Est coordinates (EPSG 3004). (database available at. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road and rail communication network (DBPRIOR10k) — Umbria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DbPrior, Servizio di accesso a mappe, Ferrovie, Rete Stradale, Data Base degli strati prioritari 10k, Viabilità. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
